Private Chat Recruitment

Recruit a Host
via Private Chat

Invite an eligible user to join your Agency directly from your conversation.

For Agents & Hosts

Before you start

All requirements must be met

  • 01You are an Agent or Host.
  • 02You have passed Face Verification.
  • 03The user has not joined any Agency yet.
  • 04The user has sent you at least one private-chat message.

Important: The target does not need Face Verification before you send the invitation.

How it works

6 steps to recruit

1

Start the conversation

Receive at least one reply

Either person may start the chat. Before you can recruit the user, they must have sent you at least one private-chat message.

The incoming message “hi” meets the reply requirement.
2

Send the invitation

Tap the Recruit icon

Tap the envelope-plus icon in the chat toolbar. It appears only when both you and the target meet the recruitment conditions.

3

Check the user

Confirm the recruitment

Review the user information in the confirmation dialog, then tap OK to send the invitation.

4

Invitation sent

Wait for the user to accept

The black Operation succeed message confirms only that the invitation was sent.

Invitation sent ≠ User joinedThe user still needs to tap Accept Now.
5

Target-side action

The user taps Accept Now

The user receives an invitation in the private chat. Recruitment is completed only after they tap Accept Now. Selecting Later does not complete it.

6

Verify the result

Check your recruitment record

Use the activity page as the reliable place to check recruited users and their current status.

  1. 1Open the activity page and tap Recruit users in app.
  2. 2View the user record in My Guide.

What happens next

The user becomes a Host

After accepting, the user joins your Agency, becomes a Host, and enters the current Salary page. Tasks and values are subject to the latest in-app display.

If the user already belongs to an Agency, they are already a Host and cannot be recruited through this flow. The Recruit icon will not appear.
